instruction.text: Belinda is taking the train from London Paddington to Bristol Temple Meads. Use the train timetable to answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How long is the train ride from London Paddington to Bristol?
How long does it take to get to Swindon from Reading?
atoms.sound: How long does it take to get to Swindon from Reding?

atoms.a: How long does it take to get to Bath from Chippenham?
At Bristol, Belinda is changing and catching the train to Taunton. The train leaves at 15:30. How long does she have to wait?

instruction.text: When she arrives in Taunton, Belinda needs to take a bus to her granny’s house which is just off Taunton Green. Use the bus timetable to answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How long is the bus ride from Taunton Station to Taunton Green?
How long does it take to get to Triscombe Road from Denmark Inn?
The bus is delayed by 4 minutes because of traffic. What time does Belinda arrive at Taunton Green?
